moves.name: Gusty Mountains Esper Wing
moves.description:
Activation Condition: When the user’s Sp. Atk is raised.
Deactivation Condition: When the user’s Sp. Atk is not raised.

Never misses. Except in certain circumstances, successful hits with this attack become critical hits. Raises the Speed of all allied sync pairs by 2 stat ranks. If the remaining MP for the user’s Go Faster! is 1 or more when attacking with this move, increases the Special Moves ↑ Next effect of all allied sync pairs by 1 rank.

moves.name: Go Faster!
moves.description: Applies the Supereffective ↑ Next effect to the user. Applies the Free Move Next effect to the user. The more the user’s Speed is raised, the more it reduces its sync move countdown (can be reduced by up to 3 maximum). The more the user’s Speed is raised, the more it increases its Special Moves ↑ Next effect (can be increased by up to 3 ranks maximum).
